'''Ruan Yi''' is a [[Boss enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|Ruan Yi had kept his anger in check for years. When a fleeting "opportunity" presented itself, he decided it was time to finally unleash his pent-up fury.}}
